City Recycling Drop-Off Information
City facilities have recycling drop-off stations for batteries,
CFL bulbs, and cell phones. We are no longer accepting
smoke detectors for recycling, please remove batteries
for recycling and place smoke detectors in the garbage.
Batteries and CFL bulbs are also accepted at Household
Hazardous Waste facilities (see right). See more CFL bulb
locations at www.lightrecycle.org.
Find more recycling options for hard to recycle items at
www.kingcounty.gov/whatdoidowith.
See event details at
kirklandwa.gov/recycle.
